changelog.summary: This update improves Linux desktop integration by adding support for XDG Notification Portals. We also fixed a crash affecting users with the Turkish language setting to ensure a stable experience.
This release focuses on internal housekeeping and packaging improvements to ensure a stable experience.

This update resolves a stability issue within the generator to ensure smoother operation. We have also included the latest definitions for two-factor authentication services and updated translations for a better localized experience.
